purpose: Small, source-pinned semantic/control corpus for superconductivity discovery benchmarking. This is not a complete candidate database or a model training set.
claim_ceiling: Literature-reported experimental observations and computational predictions are recorded separately. No prediction in this file is an experimentally confirmed superconductor.

source_register.title: Superconductivity onset above 60 K in ambient-pressure nickelate films
source_register.primary_claim_boundary: Ambient-pressure epitaxial thin films; reported onset, zero-resistance and diamagnetic transition temperatures remain distinct.

source_register.title: Bulk superconductivity up to 96 K in pressurized nickelate single crystals
source_register.primary_claim_boundary: Crystals synthesized at ambient pressure; superconducting state measured under approximately 20-22 GPa. Do not call this ambient-pressure operation.

source_register.title: High-temperature superconductivity at pressures below 30 GPa via hydrogen-unit metal embedding
source_register.primary_claim_boundary: Predicted electron-phonon superconductivity; no experimental synthesis or measured transition is encoded.

source_register.title: Genome-inspired AI for extrapolative discovery of high-temperature superconductors
source_register.primary_claim_boundary: Model predictions over crystal databases; candidate Tc values are not experimental observations. Early-access article version; data, split and checkpoint reproducibility must be audited.

source_register.title: Developing a complete AI-accelerated workflow for superconductor discovery
source_register.primary_claim_boundary: Reported 0.87 K Tc MAE is against DFT/Allen-Dynes computational labels, not measured experimental Tc. Two synthesized candidates are reported by the paper; exact candidates and artifacts require full source audit.

source_register.title: HTSC-2025: A benchmark dataset of ambient-pressure high-temperature superconductors for AI-driven critical temperature prediction
source_register.primary_claim_boundary: 155-material benchmark; labels and structural-system splits are computational and must not be merged with specimen-level experimental Tc.
source_register.note: Hugging Face tree displayed verified revision ab53472; dataset README category counts sum to 140 while paper reports 155; do not redistribute until rights clarified.

source_register.title: A framework to evaluate machine learning crystal stability predictions
source_register.primary_claim_boundary: Methodological comparator for prospective campaign metrics and budgeted candidate ranking; its crystal-stability DAF values are not superconductivity performance.

candidate_records.sample_identity_resolution: Paper-level values recorded; exact specimen/batch mapping for each observable must be extracted from full text and supplement before specimen-level fusion.
candidate_records.phase_and_process_notes: Compressive epitaxial strain on SrLaAlO4; extreme non-equilibrium gigantic-oxidative atomic-layer-by-layer epitaxy.
candidate_records.engineering_readiness: thin-film research result; no long-length conductor or device qualification encoded

candidate_records.sample_identity_resolution: Paper-level composition and pressure values recorded; exact specimen identity across transport and magnetic measurements must be checked in source data.
candidate_records.phase_and_process_notes: Ambient-pressure crystal synthesis does not imply ambient-pressure superconducting operation; superconducting observations require approximately 20-22 GPa.
candidate_records.engineering_readiness: high-pressure bulk research result; not ambient-pressure conductor

candidate_records.dynamical_stability: source abstract reports ambient-pressure dynamical stability for a subset of screened compounds; candidate-specific evidence must be extracted before admission
reported metastable R-3m phase at the calculated pressure; not an experimental phase confirmation

candidate_records.form: database structure screened by machine learning

benchmark_catalogs.metric_interpretation: computational-label regression only; not experimental Tc accuracy
benchmark_catalogs.local_reproducibility_status: not_reproduced; artifact and split closure tracked in Symthaea issue #12619

benchmark_catalogs.metric_interpretation: new non-superconductor dataset in the 29 October 2026 paper; dataset contents, schema, licenses and split manifest are not yet independently ingested
benchmark_catalogs.local_reproducibility_status: not_reproduced; request exact dataset, model weights, source code, split manifest and negative-label definition

benchmark_catalogs.metric_interpretation: computed high-Tc candidate benchmark; do not merge targets with experimental specimen records
benchmark_catalogs.local_reproducibility_status: not_reproduced; count, license, exact source records, CIFs, label provenance and grouped split manifests unresolved; tracked in #12635

non_goals: This registry is not a complete superconductivity database.
This registry is not a model training set or a leaderboard.
No experimental synthesis instructions are provided.
No candidate is authorized for experimental work by appearing here.
No calculated or machine-learning Tc is an observed transition.
